steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Hitler outlined his foreign policy aims in Mein Kampf (1925) and in a secret meeting with his generals on 5 November 1937 (the Hossbach Memorandum). His three main aims were: to destroy the Treaty of Versailles, to create a Greater Germany by uniting all German-speaking peoples, and to conquer Lebensraum (living space) in eastern Europe. | Key Fact: In March 1935, Hitler publicly announced German rearmament, directly violating the Treaty of Versailles. He introduced conscription, expanding the army from 100,000 to 550,000 men, and revealed the existence of the Luftwaffe (air force). Britain and France protested but took no action. | Key Fact: On 13 January 1935, the people of the Saar voted in a plebiscite on their future.
